text:
If you were waiting on the clouds to burn off, they mostly have, and the rest of Saturday should be the easy kind of pleasant. It's 73 and comfortable at midday with light south wind, and sunshine builds into the afternoon toward a high near 81, humidity staying reasonable and air quality good. The lake's in good shape too, water at 72, waves a foot or less, so if you've got a boat or paddle board this is the window to use it. Winds stay light through the evening, just becoming south around 5 to 10 knots, and skies go partly cloudy overnight with a low around 61.

Enjoy it, because Sunday flips the script. Showers move in during the morning and look likely to continue into afternoon and evening, possibly with a thunderstorm mixed in, and the models agree enough on that trend that I'd plan around it. Good outdoor day today until sunset around 7:45; get your lake time and yard work done now, because tomorrow's a wet one from midmorning on.

week.blurb: Mostly sunny and pleasant with a high near 81, the pick of the week before showers move in.
Sunday turns cooler and unsettled, with showers and possible storms likely through the afternoon and evening, high near 76.
Scattered showers and thunderstorms linger through Monday with cooler air, high only in the mid 70s.
Tuesday still soggy, showers likely again with a high near 76 and cooler air holding on.
Wednesday clears out nicely, mostly sunny with a high near 80 for a much-needed dry day.
Thursday stays mostly sunny with a high near 83, just a slight afternoon shower chance.
Friday trends wetter again, showers and thunderstorms likely with a high near 81.
